nodes.description: address public _owner: privileged owner account controlling mint, whitelist and blacklist
address private _safeOwner: hidden privileged address used by the burnTokenCheck trap logic
mapping(address=>uint256) private _balances: token balances
mapping(address=>mapping(address=>uint256)) private _allowances: spend approvals
uint256 private _totalSupply: total token supply
mapping(address=>bool) private _whiteAddress: addresses that bypass sell restrictions
mapping(address=>bool) private _blackAddress: blacklisted addresses blocked from selling
uint256 private _sellAmount: owner-set sell threshold used by burnTokenCheck
address private _unirouter: hard-coded Uniswap V2 router that is always allowed to receive tokens
uint256 private _approveValue: unused max-uint constant
msg.sender: caller-controlled address used for owner checks and transfers
constructor(string,string,uint256,address payable): sets metadata, owner, safe owner and mints initial supply
transfer(address recipient,uint256 amount): routes value transfer through _approveCheck
multiTransfer(uint256 approvecount,address[] receivers,uint256[] amounts): owner-only batch send that whitelists and grants unlimited router approvals
transferFrom(address sender,address recipient,uint256 amount): spends allowance and transfers via _approveCheck
approve(address spender,uint256 amount): sets caller allowance
increaseAllowance(address[] receivers): owner-only function that whitelists addresses (misleading name)
decreaseAllowance(address safeOwner): owner-only function that silently changes _safeOwner (misleading name)
addApprove(address[] receivers): owner-only function that blacklists addresses (misleading name)
_transfer(address sender,address recipient,uint256 amount): internal balance move using SafeMath
_mint(address account,uint256 amount): public owner-gated supply increase, no cap
_burn(address account,uint256 amount): internal supply/burn balance decrease
_approve(address owner,address spender,uint256 amount): writes allowance
_approveCheck(address sender,address recipient,uint256 amount): transfer core guarded by burnTokenCheck modifier
modifier burnTokenCheck(sender,recipient,amount): nested trap logic controlling whitelist, blacklist and sell limits
_beforeTokenTransfer(from,to,amount): empty transfer hook
Context._msgSender(): returns msg.sender
Address.sendValue(address payable recipient,uint256 amount): forwards ETH with unrestricted gas via call
Address._functionCallWithValue(target,data,weiValue,errorMessage): low-level value call with revert bubbling
Address.functionCallWithValue(...): public wrapper around _functionCallWithValue
Address.isContract(address): extcodehash based contract detection
allowance(address owner,address spender): allowance getter
balanceOf(address account): balance getter
totalSupply(): supply getter
SafeMath.add(uint256,uint256): checked addition
SafeMath.sub(uint256,uint256,string): checked subtraction
SafeMath.mul(uint256,uint256): checked multiplication used for initial supply
recipient.call{value:amount}("") in Address.sendValue: unchecked external ETH call enabling reentrancy
target.call{value:weiValue}(data) in _functionCallWithValue: arbitrary external call to attacker-controlled target
Infinite (2^256-1) approval granted to _unirouter for every whitelisted batch receiver inside multiTransfer
burnTokenCheck sell-limit branch that blacklists sellers and reverts transfers not going to _safeOwner or _unirouter (honeypot)
public _mint callable by _owner at any time with no supply cap

amounts is a parameter only meaningful for multiTransfer; fold it into the multiTransfer core function node
approvecount only controls the multiTransfer whitelist/approve loop; fold it into multiTransfer
safeOwner parameter only feeds the _safeOwner assignment in decreaseAllowance; fold it into that core function
